avis.titre: Effective for some, but patch testing is key for sensitive skinEffective for some, but patch testing is key for sensitiv
avis.texte: I have dry and sensitive skin, so I was hoping the Anua 2% BHA Gentle Exfoliating Toner would soothe and exfoliate without causing irritation. Unfortunately, it didn’t work out for me—it stung my face and caused some irritation, so I had to stop using it. However, the interesting thing is that it worked perfectly for my husband’s skin. He didn’t experience any stinging or irritation, and it seemed to work well for his skin type. I would recommend doing a patch test before using this toner, especially if you have sensitive skin, as it may not be suitable for everyone. For those with skin that can tolerate it, it seems to be an effective exfoliant, but definitely proceed with caution if you’re prone to irritation.

I am really impressed with the Anua BHA 2 Gentle Exfoliating Toner. It has become a great addition to my skincare routine because it helps smooth my skin, improve texture, and keep my pores feeling cleaner without being too harsh. The salicylic acid works well for gently exfoliating and helping with excess oil, clogged pores, and uneven skin texture. I appreciate that it feels lightweight and refreshing on my skin without leaving behind a sticky or heavy feeling. After using it consistently, my skin feels softer, smoother, and more balanced. It is a great option for anyone who struggles with oily skin, enlarged pores, or occasional breakouts and wants a gentle exfoliating product that can be incorporated into a daily routine. The packaging is nice, the bottle is easy to use, and a little product goes a long way. Overall, this toner provides great value and delivers noticeable results without over-drying my skin. I would definitely recommend it and would purchase it again.

Bummer - this is apparently no longer fungal acne safe. I bought this for treating my clogged pores (when it was in the former bottle/teal toned) and used it with no issues. However I ran the ingredients through skinsort and it says it's not FA safe! Not sure if the formula changed?

avis.titre: Mild but efficient especially with consistent use.
avis.texte: The only salicylic acid toner I've used that doesn't turn my skin bright red. It's very mild while still keeping your pores from getting clogged when you use it consistently.
Working wonderful! Magic in a bottle! I applying this product only for 10 minutes and had to washed it off because it's leaving skin to sticky. But even 10 minutes make skin soft and shrink pores.
Bought this for my teen daughter because it’s a bit more gentle than the one I use. She likes it. No irritation and her skin is looking great.

avis.titre: El mejor tónico salicílico que he probado
avis.texte: Como persona con piel grasa se ha convertido indispensable en mi rutina. Por la noche me lo echo en un algodón y me lo paso por la cara, y al día siguiente tengo la piel limpia y super suavecita. Es genial para reducir los poros y noto como tengo los puntos negros mas pequeños o que directamente han desaparecido. Había probado otros productos con salicílico pero en menor concentración y este es el único que de verdad a mi me ha hecho efecto, sin duda repetiré comprándolo.
Absolutely only use it twice a week, make sure to use a barrier cream in the morning to restore any stripping. Really does work for clearing up texture and little pimples forming.

I ordered this product because I am familiar with the Anua brand, their heart leaf toner went viral this past year or so (though I never tried it). Anywho, this is a Korean beauty / Asian beauty product, which I typically find to be more gentle and this doesn’t disappoint! I am a daily retinol user, so I have to be careful when it comes to exfoliants. I have been using this daily alongside .05% retinol and have not had any issues!! As well, I live at extremely high altitude and tend to have extremely dry skin as a result of that + the tretinoin, but I am able to use this toner without drying out my skin further. I am a fan of this toner, the price is what I would expect to say. I have only been using it for about a week, so it’s tough to say until I finish the bottle, but at present I think I will be repurchasing. I have used the Paula’s choice BHA toner in the past, and I do prefer the anua. Both toners primary active is salicylic acid.

avis.titre: A Very Nice Toner With a Pleasant Scent Too
avis.texte: My skin can be sensitive at times but I've found no issues using this. I'm enjoying the scent too, and I find it works well for me. I like to use toners to do a quick cleanse on a clean face sometimes just to remove grime and cut down on oils and this does the trick. A bit of nice light moisturizer afterwards and I feel fresh and invigorated. I have found this tightens my skin and tones it nicely without over drying. I think it's a good value for the price as well. A little goes a long way and for me, I usually get months of use out of a bottle this size. Really nice stuff. I'm glad I had the opportunity to try it and will likely return for more once I've run out.
Received broken and had leaked all over the box. Quite a bit of product had leaked out.

I introduced this exfoliating toner to my routine and I’m so happy I did! It left my skin so much calmer. It also gave me a glow I was not expecting. I use after I shower twice or three times a week. Then proceed with the rest of my skin care routine. You just have to remember to use sunscreen, though. This product can cause sensitive to the sun. But I’m used to that since I have used retinol and bha before.
It works as well as any other toner I've used and I really like the pump.

Always loved using Anua skincare products, and this is the second time I've ordered this toner, but unfortunately this time, it seems like it wasn't properly sealed because it leaked through it's box and the cap wasn't on when I opened it.

Completely derailed my skin progress. :( Definitely wouldn't reccomended for someone with sensitive skin, but would probably work for someone with non-sensitive acne prone skin. The person who reccomended it for sensitive skin on TikTok wanted to ruin my week. 😆 The smell was nice, didn't burn at first but, I was a complete tomato face and very hot/sensitive for a few days after use 🍅😭👺🔥
